capabilities: Run Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode agents against vault notes
Group ongoing work into projects with instructions and chat history
Save repeatable prompts as slash commands
Answer questions about a selection with Quick Ask
Use hosted, bring-your-own-key, or local models
disambiguation: Not a code-completion assistant; it runs AI agents and chat over your notes.
extras: Freemium: works without a Copilot license when you use your own agent account, provider key, or local model; hosted models and cloud-backed tools need a paid plan. Agent mode is desktop-only. The plugin frontend is open source, hosted backend services are proprietary, and paid access has a 14-day refund window.
problem: Notes in a vault cannot be handed to AI agents, so research and writing with them means leaving Obsidian and copying context by hand.

relations.evidence: OpenCode (recommended): Let Copilot download and manage it, then use Copilot-hosted models
Connect an existing installation. Copilot detects common install locations and uses your Claude Code login.
Connect Codex through the @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp adapter and use your existing Codex login.

summary: AI agent workspace that runs Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode inside Obsidian for research, writing, and knowledge work.
